neighbours.label: grammar-terminology prose: the function word right after a grammatical role is named ('the object of a preposition', 'used as a noun', 'the subject of the verb'); the same frames in other school subjects stay quiet
fire: Here the pronoun him is the object of a preposition, so it takes the objective case.
An infinitive can be used as a noun, an adjective or an adverb in a sentence.
In the passive voice the receiver of the action becomes the subject of the verb.
A participle is a verb form that works as an adjective and modifies a noun.
The word who is used when the pronoun is the subject of a clause.
An adverb clause begins with a subordinating conjunction and modifies the main verb.
The noun phrase after the linking verb is called a predicate nominative.
Use whom when the pronoun is the direct object of the verb in a relative clause.
quiet: Here the number seven is the remainder of a division, so it goes above the line.
A magnet can be used as a compass, a latch or a sensor in a machine.
In the water cycle the vapour from the ocean becomes the source of the rain.
A tendon is a band of tissue that works as a cable and moves a bone.
The word mass is used when the quantity is the amount of a substance.
A river delta begins with a slowing current and builds up the coastal plain.
The line segment across the circle is called a diameter of the figure.
Use litres when the quantity is the total volume of the liquid in a closed tank.
